ignoreAttrHelpTooltip:
[Syntax Rules & Examples]
1. Basic Rules:
• One JavaScript RegExp per line, case-insensitive (flag i)
• Empty lines ignored; lines starting with # are comments
• Invalid regex lines will be skipped with a warning

2. Matching Scope:
• Matches both display name (e.g. dailynote-20250721) and full name (e.g. custom-dailynote-20250721)

3. Common Examples:
• ^dailynote-.* : Ignore all daily note attributes starting with dailynote-
• ^(temp|test)_ : Ignore temporary attributes starting with temp_ or test_
• \d{8}$ : Ignore attributes ending with 8 digits
• # This is a comment line
ignoreAttrHint: One regex per line. Matched attributes will be hidden in notebook batch management. Lines starting with # are comments.
